blocks.text: Inkbird WIFI Wireless Meat Thermometer with 360°Readable LCD Standalone Base，4 Probes Digital Food Meat Thermometer with Remote Control for BBQ, Grill, Oven, Smoker, Rotisserie, Kitchen

items: Wireless Meat Thermometer with 3 Connection Modes： Ideal for cooking in any environment—switch between 2.4GHz WiFi (long-range), Bluetooth 5.4 (300ft), or offline mode. No more rushing back to the kitchen to check temps when hosting guests!

items.label: Precision Monitoring with 4 Probes
items.value: This food meat thermometer lets you track multiple meats at once with accuracy of ±1°F -perfect for holiday feasts or weekend barbecues. No more guesswork and no more juggling single probes. And this thermometer has a wide temperature measurement range, food temperature support range: 14~212℉, and ambient temperature support range: 32~572℉

items: Smart Control via APP：This smart meat thermometer master your cooking with the app! Features 26 USDA presets + custom programs, 5 doneness levels, and triple-alert system (high-temp/time/target). Track cooking progress via real-time graphs and receive instant alerts

Continuous Cooking & Conveneient Use：The long-lasting battery provides up to 25 hours on a quick 25-minute charge, perfect for overnight smoking sessions or all-day tailgating.The large, backlit display shows all four probe readings simultaneously, while the magnetic mount keeps it conveniently accessible on your grill or smoker

IP67 Waterproof & 30min Offline Data Storage：This digital meat thermometer is easy to clean and dishwasher safe. Additionally, it can automatically store 30 minutes of offline data when not connected to a mobile phone. Once connected to a mobile phone, the data will be synchronized immediately, so there is no need to worry about data loss. It is suitable for outdoor cooking
